entries.ko: 오늘 강연에서는 인구 고령화가 지방 재정에 미치는 영향을 살펴보겠습니다. 먼저 최근 십 년간의 통계를 바탕으로 세입과 복지 지출의 격차를 확인하고, 이어서 그 격차가 확대되는 원인을 세 가지로 나누어 분석하겠습니다. 마지막으로 단기 처방보다 구조적 개혁이 필요한 이유를 말씀드리겠습니다.
entries.g: In today's lecture we will look at the effect of population aging on local finances. First, based on statistics from the past ten years, we will check the gap between revenue and welfare spending, and then analyze, in three groups, why that gap is widening. Finally, I will explain why structural reform is needed rather than short-term remedies.

read.true: The lecturer plans to analyze why the gap is widening and to argue for structural reform.
false: The lecturer will argue that short-term remedies are sufficient.
The lecturer will skip the statistics and discuss only reform.
The lecturer says population aging has reduced welfare spending.

entries.ko: A: 공공기관의 민원 응대에 자동 번역을 도입하는 방안에 대해 말씀해 주시겠습니까? B: 편의성이 높아진다는 점은 분명합니다. 다만 법률 용어처럼 오역의 위험이 큰 분야에서는 전문가의 검수 절차를 병행해야 한다고 봅니다. A: 그렇다면 검수 비용은 누가 부담해야 한다고 보십니까? B: 제도의 혜택을 보는 공공기관이 부담하는 것이 타당합니다.
entries.g: A: Could you tell us about the idea of introducing automatic translation into public institutions' handling of civil complaints? B: It is clear that convenience would increase. However, in fields such as legal terminology, where the risk of mistranslation is high, I think expert checking should be carried out alongside. A: Then who should bear the cost of that checking? B: It is reasonable for the public institution that benefits from the system to bear it.

read.true: B supports automatic translation but wants expert checking in high-risk fields.
false: B opposes introducing automatic translation altogether.
B says the people who file complaints should pay for the checking.
B says legal terminology is the safest field for automatic translation.

entries.ko: 본 위원회는 최근 제기된 수질 오염 의혹과 관련하여 다음과 같이 입장을 밝힙니다. 현재까지의 조사 결과로는 인체에 해로운 수준의 오염이 확인되지 않았습니다. 그러나 주민들의 불안을 해소하기 위해 추가 검사를 실시하고, 그 결과를 매주 공개하도록 하겠습니다.
entries.g: The committee states its position on the recently raised suspicions of water pollution as follows. The investigation so far has not confirmed pollution at a level harmful to the human body. However, to ease residents' anxiety, we will carry out additional tests and make the results public every week.

read.true: So far no harmful pollution has been confirmed, but more tests will be done and published weekly.
false: Serious pollution has been confirmed and residents were told to leave.
The committee will keep the test results private until all work is finished.
The committee says no further testing is necessary.

entries.ko: A: 박사님은 기후 적응 정책의 가장 큰 과제로 무엇을 꼽으십니까? B: 예산보다는 부처 간 협력이라고 생각합니다. 같은 지역의 홍수 대책을 여러 기관이 따로 추진하다 보니 중복 투자가 생기고, 정작 취약 계층에게는 혜택이 닿지 않는 경우가 많습니다. A: 그렇다면 어떤 방식이 필요합니까? B: 지역 단위의 통합 계획을 세우고 성과를 함께 평가하는 체계가 필요합니다.
entries.g: A: What do you name as the biggest challenge for climate adaptation policy, Doctor? B: I think it is cooperation between ministries rather than budget. Because several agencies pursue flood measures for the same area separately, duplicate investment arises, and in many cases the benefits do not actually reach vulnerable groups. A: Then what kind of approach is needed? B: A system is needed that draws up an integrated plan at the regional level and evaluates the results together.

read.true: B considers cooperation among agencies a bigger problem than the budget.
false: B says a shortage of budget is the biggest problem.
B says agencies already coordinate their flood measures well.
B says vulnerable groups receive the most benefit from current measures.

entries.ko: 연구 윤리는 연구 결과의 신뢰성을 지탱하는 기본 조건입니다. 데이터를 임의로 고치는 행위는 물론, 출처를 밝히지 않고 타인의 표현을 가져다 쓰는 행위도 연구 부정에 해당합니다. 따라서 연구자는 결과가 가설과 다르게 나왔더라도 있는 그대로 보고할 책임이 있습니다.
entries.g: Research ethics is a basic condition that supports the reliability of research results. Not only arbitrarily altering data but also taking another person's wording without citing the source counts as research misconduct. Therefore researchers are responsible for reporting results as they are, even when they differ from the hypothesis.

read.true: Researchers should report results honestly even if they contradict the hypothesis.
false: Using someone else's wording without a source is fine if the data are correct.
Only changing data counts as research misconduct.
Results that differ from the hypothesis should be left out of the report.

entries.ko: 오늘은 한옥의 보존 문제를 문화유산 정책의 관점에서 살펴보겠습니다. 한옥은 단순한 주거 공간이 아니라 기후와 생활 방식이 응축된 문화적 결과물입니다. 그러나 현대인의 편의에 맞추어 개조하다 보면 고유한 구조가 훼손될 수 있습니다. 이 점에서 보존과 활용의 균형이 핵심 쟁점입니다.
entries.g: Today we will look at the preservation of hanok from the viewpoint of cultural heritage policy. A hanok is not merely a living space but a cultural product in which climate and way of life are condensed. However, if one remodels it for modern convenience, its distinctive structure can be damaged. In this respect, the balance between preservation and use is the key issue.

read.true: The lecturer sees the balance between preserving and using hanok as the key issue.
false: The lecturer says a hanok is only a place to live with no cultural meaning.
The lecturer says remodeling never damages a hanok's structure.
The lecturer argues that hanok should be given up in favor of modern housing.

entries.ko: A: 지역 축제가 지나치게 상업화되고 있다는 비판이 있습니다. B: 방문객 수를 성과 지표로 삼다 보니 지역 고유의 이야기가 약해진 측면이 있습니다. C: 저는 다르게 봅니다. 수익이 있어야 주민이 축제를 지속할 수 있으므로 상업성 자체를 문제 삼기는 어렵습니다. 다만 수익이 지역 공동체로 돌아가는 구조를 만드는 일이 관건입니다.
entries.g: A: There is criticism that local festivals are becoming too commercialized. B: Because visitor numbers are used as a performance indicator, the local stories unique to the area have weakened in some respects. C: I see it differently. Residents can keep a festival going only if there is income, so it is hard to object to commerciality itself. What matters is building a structure in which the income returns to the local community.

read.true: C accepts commercial income as long as it returns to the local community.
false: C argues that festivals should earn no income at all.
B says using visitor counts as a goal has strengthened local stories.
A says nobody criticizes the commercialization of festivals.

entries.ko: 본 재단은 전통 공예 보존을 위한 지원 사업의 선정 결과를 다음과 같이 발표합니다. 올해는 신청 단체 서른 곳 가운데 일곱 곳이 선정되었으며, 심사에서는 기술의 전승 가능성과 지역 사회와의 연계가 중점적으로 평가되었습니다. 선정되지 못한 단체에는 심사 의견을 서면으로 안내해 드리겠습니다.
entries.g: The foundation announces the selection results of its support program for preserving traditional crafts as follows. This year seven of the thirty applicant groups were selected, and the review focused on the possibility of passing on the skills and the ties with the local community. Groups that were not selected will be given the review comments in writing.

read.true: Seven of thirty groups were selected, and the others will get written review comments.
false: All thirty applicant groups were selected this year.
The review judged only how early each application was submitted.
Groups that were not selected will receive no feedback.

entries.ko: A: 방언이 사라지고 있다는 우려가 큽니다. 원인이 무엇이라고 보십니까? B: 방송과 교육을 통해 표준어가 널리 보급된 데다, 젊은 세대가 도시로 이동하면서 방언을 쓸 기회가 줄었기 때문입니다. A: 방언을 보존하려면 어떻게 해야 합니까? B: 기록하는 데 그치지 말고, 일상에서 실제로 쓰이도록 지역 교육과 연계해야 합니다.
entries.g: A: There is great concern that dialects are disappearing. What do you think the cause is? B: It is because the standard language has spread widely through broadcasting and education, and because young people moving to cities has reduced the opportunities to use dialect. A: What should be done to preserve dialects? B: Rather than stopping at recording them, they should be linked with local education so that they are actually used in daily life.

read.true: B says dialects should be linked to local education so they are used in daily life.
false: B says recording dialects alone is enough to preserve them.
B says young people moving to cities has increased the use of dialect.
B says the spread of the standard language has had nothing to do with the decline.

entries.ko: 오늘 강연의 주제는 번역에서 문화적 맥락을 어떻게 다룰 것인가입니다. 직역은 원문에 충실하다는 장점이 있지만 독자에게 낯선 의미를 남길 수 있습니다. 반대로 의역은 읽기 쉽지만 원문의 특성이 지워질 위험이 있습니다. 두 방식의 장단점을 사례와 함께 비교해 보겠습니다.
entries.g: The topic of today's lecture is how to handle cultural context in translation. Literal translation has the advantage of being faithful to the original, but it can leave meanings that feel strange to readers. Conversely, free translation is easy to read, but there is a risk that the character of the original is erased. We will compare the strengths and weaknesses of the two approaches with examples.

read.true: The lecturer will compare literal and free translation using examples.
false: The lecturer says literal translation always reads easily.
The lecturer says free translation always keeps the character of the original.
The lecturer says translators should ignore cultural context.
